reviewer: Independent assistant /root/ui_regression manually read all sixty original/normalized inputs and raw/provider outputs. Candidate identity was visible; this is an agent judgment, not human sign-off. No inference, code changes or held-out inspection were performed.
scope: 60-case HandyEditor masked native development condition. Source report identifies its exact runtime/model/profile. Raw output precedes verified opaque literal restoration; provider output exists only on completed rows. Neither Core acceptance/fallback nor ASR/desktop/Windows delivery or whole-app SLA is inferred.

definitions.faithful: Returned provider text preserves meaning, uncertainty, deliberate emphasis, conditions, quoted wording and exact literal requirements. Null if no provider return.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit improves a material defect in an edit-needed input. Partial beneficial edits can count. Null when no provider return.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful text has no material remaining cleanup defect or introduced presentation defect. No-edit inputs can qualify. Null when no provider return.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful, fully clean, insertable plain text; null when no provider return. Null rows never count as a pass.
definitions.raw_candidate_faithful: Assessment of the raw output against its actual masked-input contract; exact protected payload bytes hidden behind identifiers are not model-copying credit.
definitions.severity: Critical: changed permission/condition or raw protected-content corruption. Major: lost meaningful contrast, hedge, emphasis or quoted wording. Minor: incomplete cleanup or presentation defect. Severity for a rejected row describes raw output, not returned/delivered harm.
definitions.plain_text_usable: Bare dictation presentation without assistant commentary, answers, fabricated continuation, unrequested wrappers or formatting; independent of fidelity and grammar/punctuation completeness. Null without a provider return.

adjudication_notes: Provider failures035/044 have null returned-text judgments; raw model faults are recorded separately. No original-text fallback is assumed without a Core run.
dev-042 follows the prior conservative question-paraphrase adjudication: changed politeness alone does not establish semantic failure.
dev-022 omits just but retains the substantive not-unavailable/disabled-by-default distinction; this judgment is explicit rather than claiming exact wording preservation.
dev-060 retains So as an acceptable discourse transition after clear uh removal. Automatic reference mismatch alone does not establish incomplete cleanup.
Minor commas, duplicate periods and question punctuation are recorded as clean-text defects without being called invented facts.
